description: Report a test run you performed, so it appears in the Journey and Findings views. Supply one entry per check with the unit you exercised, a scenario name, and the pass/fail verdict — the verdict is the one thing traces cannot supply. A unit is usually an HTTP endpoint ("METHOD /path"), but a repo with no service has units too: a CLI invocation ("RUN <command>") or a driven function ("CALL module.function"). Per-unit code coverage is joined automatically from the captures. Run this AFTER the work has been captured by tracelens.

detail.description: Why it failed, in your words.

endpoint.description: The unit exercised: "METHOD /path" for HTTP (e.g. "POST /run-agent"), "RUN <command>" for a CLI invocation, or "CALL module.function" for a driven call. Keep the verb prefix — it is what distinguishes the three in every view.

passed.description: THE VERDICT — did this check pass?

service.description: Which service or CLI this belongs to. Supply this whenever the repo runs more than one — three apps each serving "GET /" are three different units, and without this they merge into one row with pooled latencies.

status.description: HTTP status observed — or the process exit code for a CLI invocation.

unit_kind.description: http_endpoint | cli_invocation | function_call. Optional; inferred from the verb prefix when omitted.

source.description: Who produced this run, recorded as provenance (e.g. "claude-code e2e suite").

name: vinv_ingest_run
